ops.insert: Amita Rasa Wedding Venue in Nandi Hills, Bangalore
that combines natural beauty with modern comforts? Amita Rasa could be the perfect choice. Nestled at the base of Nandi Hills, this luxury

offers green open lawns, heritage-style design, and a spacious indoor hall. Whether you’re planning a small gathering or a big celebration with 300 to 1,200 guests, Amitarasa has the space and charm to make your wedding memorable.
Outside alcohol allowed (in-house not available, corkage charges apply)
Both in-house and outside DJs permitted (late-night music restricted)
Outside caterers permitted (veg & non-veg allowed, no in-house catering)
Overnight weddings allowed (but loud music not permitted)

40 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport  


FAQs
What is the guest capacity at Amitarasa?
The venue can accommodate up to 1200 guests.
Yes, outside catering is permitted for both vegetarian and non-vegetarian menus.
What is the cost of booking Amitarasa?
The per day cost ranges from ₹14 lakh to ₹24 lakh, excluding catering.
Yes, overnight weddings are allowed, but late-night loud music is restricted.
How many rooms does Amitarasa provide?
The venue provides 7 complimentary rooms, but does not offer additional lodging.
What is the Amitarasa policy on DJs?
Both in-house and outside DJs are permitted.
Which payment methods does Amitarasa accept?
Amitarasa accepts all kinds of payments.
